answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 99 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a velvet bet on surviving 99 epochs of grading, and every sable settlement recomputes the zenith schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 14 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 19 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
